**Finding: compliant (at fallback) — no redline proposed.**

- **Our convenience right exists (§ 12.3):** AbbVie may terminate in its entirety or country-by-country "for any or no reason" on 90 days' written notice.
- **No penalty:** there is no early-termination fee or other exit charge anywhere in the agreement; § 12.10.2 merely preserves our inventory sell-off rights.
- **Harpoon has no mirror convenience right:** its termination rights are confined to material breach (§§ 12.2.1–12.2.2) and insolvency (§ 12.4) — better than the playbook fallback, which would tolerate a vendor end-of-term convenience right on 90 days' notice.
- **Noted, not flagged:** notice is 90 days rather than the preferred 30, and there is no express pro-rata refund of prepaid amounts (of limited significance in this milestone/royalty structure). These are minor sub-elements short of the preferred wording, not material deviations.
